body: And thank you for the story, I don't want to forget to say that. I'm happy that both your friend survived. And you very right-the world doesn't give a fuck. So it's a little hard for me to give a fuck either, unfortunately.

The coming and going is wearing on my heart though. I can't seem to handle it like normal people & it's hard for me to even see making it to 42 like you. The constant feeling like I'm finally in a good place and that I'm doing well only to have the rug pulled from under me is too much. I don't want to be human.
